definitions.explanation: One's existence from birth to death; the course of a person's life and experiences.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦きり→きり：noentry⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{人生|じんせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧な⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It was the happiest day of my life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}→波乱万丈：06378_haranbanjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人生|じんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: He lived a turbulent life full of ups and downs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{人生|じんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}える→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: When you look back on life as you get older, even the failures of your youth seem like good experiences.

notes:
{人生|じんせい} refers to human life as a whole journey or experience.
